inputs.prompt:
How the reference pictures align with the target video — <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video; <Picture 2> (from [Shot 2]) aligns with the 5.00-second mark of the target video.

integrated_multimodal_description: Photorealistic cinematic film, 35mm with natural grain, warm tungsten work lamps and a cool blue glow from the gadget, rain streaking the dark skylight, real unretouched skin with visible pores. Keep exactly the faces and costumes of the two men in <Picture 1>; their faces must stay the same people in every frame. The pirate: red patterned bandana, dark deep-set eyes, hollow cheeks, long pointed dark goatee and thin moustache, silver hoop earring, long dark dreadlocks threaded with colourful beads, weathered brown leather coat. The inventor: wild shaggy grey-white hair, brass goggles pushed up on his forehead, very wide pale-blue eyes, short dark beard and moustache, grey work shirt under a stained white lab coat. Normal real-time speed, no slow motion. The inventor (S1) has an excitable, quick, energetic male voice. The pirate (S2) has a deep, gravelly male voice with a dry, teasing edge. SPEED IS CRITICAL: everything moves at normal real-time speed, like 24fps footage played back at 24fps - fast, natural motion, NO slow motion. Nobody freezes or holds a pose: bodies, hands, heads and the camera keep moving until the very last frame. [Shot 1] 0-2.5 s: the over-the-shoulder medium close-up of <Picture 1>; the camera drifts in. 0-1 s: the pirate leans in on both elbows, tilting the head and narrowing the eyes at the gadget. 1-2.5 s: the pirate taps the gadget's glass twice with a fingertip and the pirate (S2) asks, one eyebrow climbing: "So... what does it do?" [Shot 2] 2.5-5 s: hard cut to the reverse angle, a handheld close-up of the inventor from the other side of the bench, already in motion. 2.5-3 s: he rocks forward over the bench, rubbing his hands. 3-4.3 s: the inventor (S1) whispers with his eyebrows bouncing: "It makes your hair... louder." 4.3-5 s: he bursts into a giddy laugh, head tipping back, shoulders shaking, hands still rubbing, arriving at <Picture 2> on the very last frame.

overall_soundscape: Rain on the skylight and the gadget's steady hum under both shots; two light glassy taps on the gadget, a leather creak as the pirate leans in, the bench creaking as the inventor rocks forward, his breathy giggle.
